fusions.name: Trophy Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a shot that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets. It always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Blood Trail
fusions.desc: A cut that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds. You have +6% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Closing In
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 6. When it reaches 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
